name: azulejo
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity native Android app design for RachaConta, helping Brazilian university friends split a boteco or restaurant bill equally. Show ONE coherent visual concept called Azulejo do campus through TWO finished screens side by side, each at 390 x 844 logical portrait viewport; total board approximately 804 x 844 with narrow neutral gutter. App content only, edge to edge: no phone body, bezel, notch, OS status bar, browser chrome, external captions or device shadows.

This direction evokes Brazilian neighborhood boteco tilework and evenings among friends through a deep bottle-green top band, warm ivory working surface and ochre primary actions with dark text. Use a small geometric green-and-ivory azulejo strip as the sole decorative signature at the header edge, away from fields. Compact personable wordmark and clean rounded sans UI text; no paper grain, illustrations or slogans. Calm strong hierarchy and generous spacing, Android-familiar switches and buttons, 48dp touch targets, readable 14–16sp labels.

Left reading order: “RachaConta” in header and “A conta é da turma”; editable “Valor da conta” with “R$ 100,00”; “Pessoas” with minus, 3, plus; “Serviço opcional” with switch OFF and inactive editable “10%”; helper “Só se ainda não estiver na conta.”; “Nome do encontro (opcional)” containing “Pizza de sexta”; primary “Calcular divisão”; secondary “Usar exemplo”.

Right header: back arrow, “Resultado”, “Pizza de sexta”. Lead immediately with “Cada um paga” and large stacked amounts: “R$ 33,33” paired with “2 pessoas”, then “R$ 33,34” paired with “1 pessoa”. Helper “Os centavos fecham o total.” A quiet lower breakdown shows “Conta R$ 100,00”, “Serviço R$ 0,00”, “Total R$ 100,00”. Familiar switch OFF “Incluir serviço de 10%”; bottom “Editar conta”. Keep both screens usable, not posters, with crisp Portuguese text and no extra features, tabs, payment flows, flags or carnival clichés.
